description: This file contains JavaScript code for the Accounts module in a CRM system. It includes functions to set form return values, manipulate address fields, integrate with Google Maps, handle address updates, and interoperate with other pages via window objects. It also references external JavaScript files related to inventory, mail, and merging functionalities.

methods.name: set_return(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets selected product ID and name in the opener window form, depending on the 'from_link' element value.

methods.name: set_return_specific(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets account-related product ID and name in the opener window's specific form, based on 'from_link' value.

methods.description: Updates the Email module to add relations between accounts and emails via URL redirection.

methods.description: Populates the address fields in the opener window with provided address details, with a confirmation prompt for overwriting existing data.
